title: Localization Quality Assurance & Testing Suite
subtitle: Interactive compliance checklist and automated verification matrix for the three official languages.
checklistSubtitle: Real-time verification status across all system requirements.

item1.title: Three Required Languages Implemented
item1.desc: English (en), Traditional Chinese (zh-TW), and Taiwanese Hokkien (nan-TW). No Persian or Simplified Chinese.

item2.title: Global Header Language Selector
item2.desc: Dropdown options: English, 繁體中文, 台灣台語. Accessible across every page and state.

item3.title: Instant Switching Without Reload
item3.desc: Application state, active forms, and current route preserved with zero page reload.

item4.title: Persistent Preference in Storage
item4.desc: Active locale saved to localStorage and restored automatically on page return.

item5.title: Zero Untranslated English in zh-TW & nan-TW
item5.desc: Every visible string, button, table header, chart, and dialog is localized in all three languages.

item6.title: Independent Taiwanese Hokkien (Taigi) Content
item6.desc: Authentic Taiwanese Han writing and Tâi-lô romanization, never mechanically copied from Mandarin.

item7.title: Strict Traditional Chinese Character Set
item7.desc: No Simplified Chinese glyphs used in Traditional Chinese or Taiwanese Hokkien locales.

item8.title: Complete Technical Terminology Alignment
item8.desc: Digital Identity, Household Registration, Verifiable Credentials, ZKP, and DID properly translated.

terminologySubtitle: Official translation dictionary across English, Traditional Chinese, and Taiwanese Hokkien.

liveTest.description: Switch languages directly below to witness immediate reactivity and component state retention.
